# Ambient occlusion (SSAO)

Darkens creases, corners and contact points where ambient light is blocked, from a normal-oriented hemisphere of samples around each pixel. It renders at reduced resolution and is smoothed by a blur that stops at edges.

<EffectDemo effect="ssao" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { ssao } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/ssao';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(ssao({ preset: 'subtle' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.radius = 0.8`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type      | Default     | Range                | Description                                                         |
| ------------ | --------- | ----------- | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `radius`     | number    | `0.8`       | 0.05 – 4 scene units | How far around each point to look for occluders.                    |
| `intensity`  | number    | `2`         | 0 – 4                | Strength of the darkening; 0 turns it off.                          |
| `samples`    | integer   | `16`        | 4 – 64               | Samples per pixel: more are smoother and slower.                    |
| `bias`       | number    | `0.02`      | 0 – 0.2              | Depth tolerance that stops flat surfaces from shadowing themselves. |
| `blur`       | number    | `2`         | 0 – 8 px             | Radius of the edge-aware blur that smooths the noise.               |
| `resolution` | number    | `0.5`       | 0.25 – 1             | Occlusion buffer size relative to the frame.                        |
| `color`      | hex color | `'#000000'` |                      | Color of fully occluded areas.                                      |
| `debug`      | boolean   | `false`     |                      | Show the occlusion buffer alone.                                    |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                     |
| --------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `subtle`  | `intensity: 0.8`, `radius: 0.4`              |
| `contact` | `radius: 0.15`, `intensity: 2`, `bias: 0.01` |
| `wide`    | `radius: 2`, `intensity: 1.2`, `samples: 24` |
| `tinted`  | `color: '#2a1840'`, `intensity: 2`           |
| `debug`   | `debug: true`                                |

Apply one with `ssao({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Atmosphere & lighting · tracked as story X10.2 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it. It also renders its own intermediate passes before the merged pass.
- **Geometry buffers:** reads depth and normals, which the composer renders only while an effect needs them.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 8.1 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/ssao`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Normal-oriented hemisphere SSAO after Chapman, SSAO tutorial (2011), and the Crytek approach (Mittring, Finding next gen, 2007); Interleaved gradient noise (Jimenez, Next generation post processing in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, 2014); Depth-aware separable blur.
